data.name: Rikhil
data.gender_notes: Rikhil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rikhil is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rik' which means 'Lord' and 'Khil' which means 'Wealth'. It is a name for a child who is believed to bring prosperity and abundance in his life. The name Rikhil carries the meaning “Lord of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rikhil usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rikhil is a name that signifies the blessings of the Hindu god, Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe and the giver of wealth and prosperity.
data.etymology: Rikhil belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rikhil total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Rikhil was a legendary king of Magadha, mentioned in the Mahabharata. He was a contemporary of the Pandava brothers and was known for his strength, wisdom and generosity.

Rikhil is also mentioned in the Buddhist Jataka tales as a generous and kind king who ruled over Magadha around the 6th century BC. He was known for his charitable donations and his ability to settle disputes peacefully.
